# Locally served browser dependencies

These pinned, unmodified distributions are served locally so the interface
does not depend on third-party JavaScript CDNs at runtime.

| Package | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap CSS + bundle | 5.3.3 | https://getbootstrap.com/ |
| Bootstrap Icons CSS + WOFF2 | 1.13.1 | https://icons.getbootstrap.com/ |
| GSAP + ScrollTrigger | 3.13.0 | https://gsap.com/ |
| Lenis JS + CSS | 1.3.11 | https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis |
| Lottie light SVG renderer | 5.13.0 | https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web |

Files were obtained from pinned npm package distributions through jsDelivr.
Keep their copyright/license headers and the included license files when
updating. GSAP's distribution identifies its license at
https://gsap.com/standard-license (also in the JS file headers).

The SAGBS logo is the owner-supplied `static/images/SAGBS_LOGO.png`, displayed
without changing its artwork. `static/sagbs/workflow.json` is an original
animation. `social-card.png` is rendered from the project's SVG layout and
includes the supplied logo.
Typography uses Google Fonts with local system fallbacks.
